title: The 10 Best Cordless Lawn Mowers
subtitle: Battery-powered push and self-propelled lawn mowers, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A cordless lawn mower starts with a button, needs no gas or oil changes and is much quieter than a gas mower. We ranked 10 best-sellers from Greenworks, EGO, WORX and MZK on rating, review volume and features (a 21-inch deck, self-propelled drive, a brushless motor and two batteries). Size the deck and battery to your lawn.

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: Greenworks 40V 16" Cordless Push Lawn Mower, 4.0Ah Battery and Charger (25322)

specs.extras: Mulch and bag, 3-year warranty, 35% lighter than steel decks

products.verdict: The best-selling and most-reviewed cordless mower here: a light 16-inch Greenworks that cuts up to 1/3 acre per charge, mulches or bags, and carries a 3-year warranty.
products.best_for: Small to medium lawns where light weight and price matter most.
products.skip_if: You have a big lot; a 21-inch deck finishes faster.

products.name: Greenworks 48V (24V x 2) 17" Cordless Push Lawn Mower, Two 4.0Ah Batteries (MO48B01)
products.verdict: A 17-inch mower that runs on two 24V batteries you can also use in Greenworks' 24V hand tools.
products.skip_if: You want the best-rated small mower; it's 4.1 stars.

products.name: Greenworks 60V 21" Brushless Self-Propelled Lawn Mower, Two 4.0Ah Batteries (MO60L424)
products.verdict: A full-size 21-inch self-propelled mower with a brushless motor, rear-wheel drive and two 4.0Ah batteries, for well under EGO's self-propelled price.
products.best_for: Larger lawns and slopes on a reasonable budget.

products.name: MZK 40V (2 x 20V) 16" Brushless Cordless Lawn Mower (ET2602)
products.verdict: A budget brushless 16-inch mower with two 20V 4.0Ah batteries and a 40 L bag. Its 202 reviews are shared with MZK's 13-inch mower.
products.best_for: Small lawns on a tight budget.
products.skip_if: You want a big brand's dealer network.
cons: Reviews shared with another MZK mower

products.name: EGO POWER+ Cordless Push Lawn Mower with 56V 4.0Ah Battery (LM2112)
products.verdict: An EGO push mower with a brushless motor that EGO says delivers more cutting torque than gas mowers, and up to 35 minutes on its 4.0Ah battery.
products.skip_if: You need more than 35 minutes per charge.
cons: Deck size not stated in bullets

products.name: EGO POWER+ 21" Cordless Push Lawn Mower with 6.0Ah Battery (LM2114)
products.verdict: A 21-inch EGO push mower with a 6.0Ah battery for up to 55 minutes, seven cutting heights and fast charging.
products.best_for: Medium lawns with a push mower budget.
products.skip_if: You mow slopes; get a self-propelled model.

products.name: EGO POWER+ 21" Self-Propelled Lawn Mower with Two 6.0Ah Batteries (LM2134SP-2)

specs.extras: Touch Drive self-propel, up to 7.0 ft-lbs torque (EGO's claim)

products.verdict: EGO's 800 Series self-propelled mower with two 6.0Ah batteries for up to 100 minutes of mowing and Touch Drive speed control.
products.best_for: Large lawns that used to need a gas mower.
products.skip_if: You're on a budget; it's the priciest here.

products.name: Greenworks 60V 21" Push Lawn Mower with Steel Deck, 5.0Ah Battery (MO60L516)

specs.extras: 4-in-1 (mulch, bag, side discharge, leaf mode), IPX4, 4-year warranty

products.verdict: A 21-inch steel-deck push mower that Greenworks says matches a 150cc gas mower, with self-sharpening dual blades, an IPX4 rating and a 4-year warranty.
products.best_for: Medium lawns where a steel deck and long warranty matter.

products.name: WORX 40V (2 x 20V) 17" Brushless Cordless Lawn Mower for 1/4 Acre (WG745)
products.verdict: A WORX brushless mower running on two Power Share batteries, rated for about a quarter acre.
products.best_for: WORX owners with small to mid yards.

products.name: Greenworks 80V 21" Brushless Self-Propelled Lawn Mower, 4.0Ah Battery (MO80L416)
products.verdict: An 80V self-propelled steel-deck mower that cuts up to 1/2 acre per charge, on Greenworks' pro 80V platform.

avoid.name: Litheli Electric Lawn Mower Cordless, 13 in Cutting Width, for 1300 Sq. Ft.
avoid.flag: Rated for 1,300 sq ft per charge
avoid.verdict: The listing itself says it mows about 1,300 sq ft per charge, a tiny fraction of what the mowers we rank cover, and it's rated 3.7 stars.
reasons: It 'can mow up to 1,300 sq. ft.' on a full charge, about 1/33 of an acre. The Greenworks 25322 is rated for up to 1/3 acre (about 14,500 sq ft).
Its model number (EGT010172) and part number (U20LM00-0A110) don't match, which makes parts and blades harder to find.
It's rated 3.7 stars on 967 reviews, the lowest of the mowers we looked at with more than a few dozen reviews.

buyers_guide.q: What deck size do I need?
buyers_guide.a: 16 to 17 inches suits small lawns and tight spaces. 21 inches is the standard for medium and large lawns and cuts the job down by about a quarter.
Makers quote coverage on flat, dry grass. Greenworks rates its 16-inch 40V model at 1/3 acre and its 80V self-propelled at 1/2 acre. Thick or wet grass cuts that a lot; a second battery helps.
On slopes or lawns over about 1/4 acre, yes. Self-propelled mowers drive the wheels so you only steer.
Brushless motors run cooler and get more mowing from each charge. They're standard on the 60V and 80V Greenworks and EGO mowers here.
Mower batteries are expensive. Pick a platform (EGO, Greenworks, WORX) whose trimmers and blowers you'll also use, so one charger and set of packs runs everything.
